evidence: The metal precursors used, Mn(thd) 3 and Co(thd) 2 (thd = 2,2,6,6-tetramethylheptane-3,5-dionate), were synthesized according to methods described by Hammond et al. 23 and purified by sublimation. Ozone generated from oxygen gas (99.999%) in an ozone generator (Fischer model 502) was used as an oxygen source.
